scope: G4 read-only independent G2 video-track audit. No semantic visual or audio approval; no generation; does not alter G2 files/manifests/delivery.
method: PyAV libavformat metadata plus independent full sequential video decode counting every presented frame and PTS/duration; separate complete audio decode for codec-padding distinction. No OpenCV metadata frame-count shortcut. Incremental checks may reuse full-decode evidence only for identical SHA and file metadata, with a new identity check.

selection.clarification: 整段只采用本次picture-repair-candidates.json及picture-live-index.json路径与SHA一致的有版本候选；不把无版本Vxx.mp4或旧assembled base当最终。presentable子片只按其当前同名JSON/SHA核对，不宣称覆盖G2其他更高优先级子片或用户通过。

decoded.paddingNote: AAC decode can include trailing codec padding; compare metadata end separately, no listening conclusion.

coverage.interpretation: Only actual decoded-frame temporal coverage is checked. An uncovered tail is not a claim of visible black frames; players may hold the last frame. Audio content/listening and picture semantics are out of scope.
